youtube_description:
Want to bring along your non-collapsible, telescoping hiking poles for your run with your Salomon Adv Skin hydration vest? You can! I'll show you how. 

My vest is the Adv Skin 12, but this probably works for the Skin 8, Skin 5, and other vests with straps in similar positions.
